svg.title: How the dashboard reaches its readers
svg.desc: Every two hours, after a change of the changelog and on demand, the Dashboard workflow runs dashboard.py, which reads what GitHub shows of every public repository of the owner: its releases, pull requests, runs and reports, and its Scorecard, and once a week asks GitHub's code search for the public repositories of other owners made with the blueprint. It writes the page and beside it the same data as repos.json, the health of each day as history.json, the 30 newest releases as the Atom feed releases.atom and the repositories of other owners as made-with.json. GitHub Pages publishes them at addresses that stay, and the job that publishes asks for each file. People read the page, the owner's website reads repos.json, and feed readers follow releases.atom.
